The '''Emperor's fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], seen in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> As indicated by the name, it was under the direct command of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], and used for instances that was important enough to require the Emperor to be personally involved.

==History==
This naval unit was assembled to accompany [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on a visit to the under-construction [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. It consisted of at least eight vessels, including several [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="TFUvg" /> and several vessels with design features similar to the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class]], including a similar hull design.<ref name="TFUc">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' graphic novel]]</ref>
